title: 1Password Reports Security Breach, Confirms Vaults Are Safe
excerpt: Password manager 1Password reports a recent data breach but assures customers that their sensitive information and logins remain secure.
body_html:
Popular password manager 1Password has confirmed that it experienced a security breach. However, the company has reassured its customers that their sensitive information and login credentials remain secure.

According to the company's statements, user vaults were not compromised during the incident. 1Password continues to maintain that sensitive user data is safe despite the unauthorized access event.
